description: Defines the AppState class which manages a boolean flag indicating whether onboarding has been completed, extending ChangeNotifier for state management and notifying listeners on change.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A class that holds the application state related to onboarding status and notifies listeners of changes.

methods.name: setOnboarded
methods.description: Sets the _hasOnboarded flag and notifies listeners to update dependents.
